text_excerpt: The SilenceMax Pro noise-cancelling headphones compete at the top of a crowded market. Their active noise cancellation ranks among the best available, effectively neutralizing airplane engine noise and other low-frequency sounds. Audio tuning favors popular genres with emphasized bass and clear midrange, though classical listeners may find the treble restrained. Battery performance matches the manufacturer's extended rating, and fast charging provides hours of playback from minutes of charging. Long-wearing comfort is good for most head shapes, with some users reporting pressure during extended sessions. The companion application offers useful customization but has exhibited occasional issues with settings retention after updates. Telephone call quality is acceptable in quiet environments but struggles in wind. Priced alongside established
